purpose: Teach: 乗務/境遇/エキスパート/未経験/県議会/等級/書名/修得

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急乗務員との連携を強化されますね
lines.en: The police are strengthening their coordination with emergency response teams.
lines.style: Observational, slightly formal. Steady pace. Warm acknowledgment — admiring the system working well. Light lift at the end, like he's nodding along.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者ご家族の境遇に丁寧に対応されますね
lines.en: The police handle victim families' situations with real care and attention.
lines.style: Gentle, respectful tone. Slightly slower pace to honor the sensitivity. Quiet conviction — not performing respect, genuinely moved by it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪心理のエキスパートと連携されますね
lines.en: They're coordinating with criminal psychology experts to handle cases better.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Light emphasis on expertise. Collaborative tone — seeing this as a sign of smart thinking, not bureaucracy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、未経験者の警察官にも研修されてますね
lines.en: Even officers new to the force are getting proper training and support.
lines.style: Warm approval. Even cadence. The pleasure of seeing systems that actually work. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、県議会で防犯予算を申請されますね
lines.en: They go to the prefectural assembly to secure funding for crime prevention.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but positive. Light pace. Casual respect — he's noticing they do the work behind the scenes that people don't usually see.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪の等級分けで対応を変えられますね
lines.en: They adjust their response depending on how serious the crime is.
lines.style: Pragmatic, nodding tone. Even delivery. Not flashy — just sensible work. Quiet approval underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の書名表記を統一されますね
lines.en: They keep their official statements formatted consistently so everything lines up.
lines.style: Slight wry warmth. The tone of someone noticing organizational detail. Dry appreciation for boring but necessary work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警察官が新技術を修得する研修を行いますね
lines.en: Young officers are getting trained in the latest techniques and technology.
lines.style: Warmer than before, closer. Genuine interest. The tone shifts slightly — more personal investment, less formal. Small smile underneath.
